title: Gazette Extraordinary No. 2500/106 — tax-invoice effective-date amendment
note: Moves the effective date in Gazette 2481/22 from 1 July 2026 to 1 October 2026; all other matters remain unchanged.

title: Gazette Extraordinary No. 2481/22 — tax-invoice format and specification
note: Defines the mandatory invoice title, supplier and purchaser details, serial structure, dates, supply details and LKR value fields. Effective date reflects Gazette 2500/106.

title: Gazette Extraordinary No. 2456/02 — Risk-Based Refund Scheme
note: Legal source for the risk-based VAT refund scheme used by the refund-readiness rule pack.

title: Circular SEC/2025/E/06 — Risk-Based Refund Scheme
note: Operational guidance for the scheme. Production rules still require professional review.

verification.against: IRD Circulars listing, which lists this circular as "Risk Based Refund Scheme. Circular No. SEC/2025/E/06 [19.11.2025]".
verification.correction: publicationDate was 2025-09-22. That is the date of notice PN/SVAT/2025-01 (22.09.2025), not of this circular.

title: Value Added Tax — rates, registration and responsibilities
note: IRD reference page currently lists the standard VAT rate as 18% from 1 January 2024 and exports under the zero-rate section.

title: Guidelines for Taxpayer Registration — 2026
note: Official sequence and supporting-document guide for TIN, PIN/SSID and VAT tax-type registration, including turnover, voluntary, import/export, new-business and temporary routes.

title: Application for Tax Type Registration — TPR 005
note: Official tax-type application form covering VAT business activity, dates, values, address, registration basis and cash-basis request.

title: Taxpayer Registration and Access to e-Services
note: Official online registration entry point. TIN and an e-Services PIN are prerequisites for authenticated online tax services.

title: VAT schedule downloads
note: Official source for output, input, import, credit/debit-note, deemed-input and export schedule templates.

title: Schedule File Verifier Tool
note: Official verifier download. ComplyPilot adds cross-document evidence reconciliation; it does not replace this structural check.

title: Quick Guide for Value Added Tax (VAT) — 2025
note: Reference workflow for filing returns and schedules through IRD e-Services.

title: Notice SEC/PN/VAT/2026-03 — National e-Invoicing Web API
note: Describes phased ERP-to-RAMIS Web API onboarding, current Schedule 01/04/07 scope, purchaser approval and the ramis.webapi@ird.gov.lk contact channel.

title: How to Submit Invoice via Web API — VAT Quick Guide
note: Published flow uses SSID/password authentication to obtain JWT, then transmits invoice data for RAMIS processing and later schedule verification.

title: Circular SEC/2026/E/03 — Revised Tax Invoice Format
note: Explains the revised invoice fields and numbering. Effective date is normalized to the later binding Gazette 2500/106.

title: Inactive VAT Registration List
note: The prototype stores only snapshot metadata. It must not be treated as real-time supplier status.

title: Customs Import Tariff — 2026
note: Advisory reference only; Customs states the web tariff information is not legal evidence.

title: Commodity Classification Branch — HS guidance
note: Used to support a human-reviewed HS-code evidence check, never autonomous classification.
